summary.walkthrough: This pull request introduces a new feature for handling code relocation in comments when deterministic positioning fails. It adds a re-location template and associated logic to utilize an LLM for generating code snippets based on comments and diffs.

change_groups.title: Re-location feature implementation
change_groups.summary: This group of changes implements the re-location feature for comments that fail deterministic positioning. It includes the creation of a new re-location template, modifications to the review command to load this template, and the addition of functions to build messages for the LLM to generate code snippets. Tests have also been added to ensure the functionality works as expected.

change_groups.title: Directory summarization feature
change_groups.summary: This group introduces a directory summarization feature that groups indexed paths by their parent directories and asks the LLM to summarize each directory. It includes the implementation of the summarization logic, template rendering, and tests to validate the functionality.

summary.testing_notes: To test the re-location feature, run the review command on a set of comments that are expected to fail deterministic positioning and verify that the LLM generates appropriate code snippets. Additionally, ensure that directory summarization works by indexing a repository and checking the summaries generated for directories.
summary.risk: medium: The introduction of LLM-based features may lead to unexpected behavior if the LLM responses are not handled correctly.
